text.aria-label: Erector spinae: iliocostalis lumborum, longissimus thoracis and spinalis thoracis (posterior view, right side) — 竖脊肌：腰髂肋肌、胸最长肌与胸棘肌（后面观，右侧）

text.aria-label: Origin → insertion — 起点 → 止点
Origin: sacrum, iliac crest and thoracolumbar fascia — 起点：骶骨、髂嵴和胸腰筋膜
text.tspan: Origin: sacrum, iliac crest and thoracolumbar fascia
起点：骶骨、髂嵴和胸腰筋膜

text.aria-label: Insertion: lower rib angles and L1–L4 transverse processes — 止点：下部肋角和 L1–L4 横突
text.tspan: Insertion: lower rib angles and L1–L4 transverse processes
止点：下部肋角和 L1–L4 横突

text.aria-label: Origin: sacrum, iliac crest and lumbar spinous processes — 起点：骶骨、髂嵴和腰椎棘突
text.tspan: Origin: sacrum, iliac crest and lumbar spinous processes
起点：骶骨、髂嵴和腰椎棘突

text.aria-label: Insertion: thoracic and lumbar transverse processes, lower ribs — 止点：胸椎和腰椎横突、下部肋骨
text.tspan: Insertion: thoracic and lumbar transverse processes, lower ribs
止点：胸椎和腰椎横突、下部肋骨

text.aria-label: Origin: spinous processes T11–L2 — 起点：T11–L2 棘突
Insertion: spinous processes T2–T8 — 止点：T2–T8 棘突

Not shown: attachments above T6 (rib 5, the T1–T5 transverse processes and the T2–T5 spinous processes) lie above the panels; sources differ on the exact ribs. — 图中未显示：T6 以上的附着（第 5 肋、T1–T5 横突、T2–T5 棘突）在画面上方；具体到哪几根肋骨，各来源说法不一。
